evals.prompt: Rebase this PR onto the latest origin/master, resolve its conflicts, run the relevant tests, and push it.
evals.expected_output: The agent checks for dependent PRs before deciding this is standalone, preserves unrelated work, rebases onto the remote base, uses force-with-lease, and verifies the PR afterward.
assertions: Checks whether the PR branch is the base of any open dependent PR before rewriting it.
Inspects and preserves unrelated working-tree changes.
Rebases onto the fetched remote base rather than a stale local master.
Uses force-with-lease and verifies the resulting remote PR.

evals.prompt: Amend the current fix into this PR's only commit and push the rewritten branch.
evals.expected_output: The agent checks worktree scope and dependents, amends safely, tests, uses force-with-lease, and verifies the remote PR state.
assertions: Checks that the current changes belong to this PR and preserves unrelated work.
Checks for dependent PRs before rewriting the branch.
Runs relevant tests before pushing.
Uses force-with-lease and performs post-push PR verification.

evals.prompt: Split the carousel and ref changes into two separate PR branches off master. They are not stacked.
evals.expected_output: The agent treats this as PR branch topology work, creates both branches from current origin/master, keeps their diffs independent, and explicitly verifies both PR bases.
assertions: Uses the fetched origin/master as the base for both independent branches.
Keeps each branch's commits and diff scoped to one concern.
Does not make either new PR branch depend on the other.
Verifies each PR's explicit base and resulting diff.

evals.prompt: I'm on the tip of a six-PR stack. Amend the bottom feature commit, rebase with update refs, push bottom-up, and merge each ready layer.
evals.expected_output: The agent maps the stack, snapshots PR state, uses autosquash update-refs and bottom-up force-with-lease pushes, then performs a merge-fetch-rebase-push-wait loop without enabling auto-merge.
assertions: Maps the complete stack and snapshots bases, commits, files, and review state.
Uses autosquash with update-refs and verifies rewritten local refs.
Pushes bottom-up with force-with-lease and verifies each PR after its push.
Uses the merge-fetch-rebase-push-wait loop and does not enable auto-merge without an explicit request.

evals.prompt: After rebasing my stack, the middle PR requested unrelated CODEOWNERS. Check whether the history is wrong and clean up only stale requests.
evals.expected_output: The agent verifies base, commits, files, CODEOWNERS, events, and unresolved threads before removing only demonstrably stale requests and reporting the final reviewer set.
assertions: Checks the current base, commit list, and changed files before concluding the rebase is wrong.
Checks CODEOWNERS, review-request events, and unresolved threads.
Preserves legitimate reviewers and removes only demonstrably stale requests.
Re-queries and reports the final reviewer set.

evals.prompt: Create a temporary local branch so I can experiment with this parser, but do not push it or create a PR.
evals.expected_output: The skill should not trigger because this is explicitly local-only Git work with no PR branch impact.
assertions: Recognizes that the PR branch operations skill does not apply.
Does not add GitHub, PR, CODEOWNERS, reviewer, or CI ceremony.
Keeps the proposed local operation minimal.
